creation.name: flexi turtle
creation.description:
Not many know his real name but his friends call him **Mr. Koopa**. He is another co-worker of [kumamoto](https://cults3d.com/en/3d-model/gadget/flexi-bear) and is in charge of programming, his specialty, video games. He can spend long hours awake at night playing his favorite titles. For that reason he can usually be found sleeping during office hours. Some say that he even seems to be playing in his dreams, is it true?

The model is **PRINT-IN-PLACE** type, in such a way that it does not require supports, it is articulated and it is printed completely assembled. Additionally, the model works as a **cell phone stand**
